run_requirements.task_identity: exact frozen task ID and parent snapshot commit
run_requirements.selected_bytes: exact sum of independently read snapshot blob lengths
run_requirements.stable_projection: task identity plus complete ordered ranked items; excludes runtime latency

replay_requirement: target and replay stable projections must be byte-identical for every validation task
observer_requirement: A separately supplied Quality-owned observer receipt must hash-bind the complete candidate, closed input inventory, measured latency, selected bytes, output projection, and independently observed process boundary.
